hints.tr: `for attempt in range(1, 6):` içinde iste ve yazdır; `if r.status_code == 200: break`; değilse `time.sleep(1)`.
hints.en: Inside `for attempt in range(1, 6):` request and print; `if r.status_code == 200: break`; otherwise `time.sleep(1)`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import time

import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"

for attempt in range(1, 6):
    r = requests.get(BASE + "/flaky", timeout=5)
    print("attempt", attempt, r.status_code)
    if r.status_code == 200:
        break
    time.sleep(1)

body = r.json()
print("report:", body["report"])
print("after attempt:", body["attempt"])
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import time

import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"

for attempt in range(1, 6):
    r = requests.get(BASE + "/flaky", timeout=5)
    print("attempt", attempt, r.status_code)
    if r.status_code == 200:
        break
    time.sleep(1)

body = r.json()
print("report:", body["report"])
print("after attempt:", body["attempt"])
```

hint.tr: Üç istek olmalı ve aralarında en az 1 saniye beklenmeli.
hint.en: There should be three requests with at least 1 second between them.
